title: YZF-R15M V4 Quickshifter
description: The Yamaha YZF-R15M V4 Quickshifter is engineered for blistering apex speeds and track dominance, occupying a prominent position in the Middleweight Sportbike segment. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck stance and a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, prioritizing aerodynamic tuck and front-end circuit precision over casual urban commuting.
